conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Mosaic
style.description: Byzantine / Roman tesserae mosaic built tile by tile: on a bed of wet grey lime plaster with a faint red-ochre underdrawing (sinopia), small hand-cut stone and glass tiles are pressed in one after another along the contour lines of the image (opus vermiculatum: rows of tiles trace the outlines first, then fill inward; the gold ground is laid in rows that ripple outward from the figure), not on a pixel grid. Rows are iso-contours of an exact distance transform of the picture's regions, traced by marching squares and resampled at tile pitch. Each tile is a slightly irregular, slightly tilted 3D chip (stone matte, smalti glossy, gold-leaf glass metallic), so when a low light sweeps across, the gold tiles glint one after another in a travelling shimmer. Once set a tile never moves. The grout darkens at the end and the camera pulls back to the whole bordered panel. Clicks are one per short bin of the same tile schedule, so the sound density follows the laying.
motion: Every tile has one set time from tessera.js; it drops 11 cm, presses 6 mm into the plaster over 0.24 s, then never moves again.

Rows are contour lines of the picture (distance-transform iso-lines), laid progressively from a phase anchor: outlines first, then inner rows, then the gold ground rippling outward from the figure, then the border.
Gold tiles carry a random tilt (~7 deg), so the travelling point light catches them one after another.
Camera: three locked shots joined by three short eased moves (no drift); set tiles never move, so holds compress well even while new tiles drop in.

notes.mechanism: tessera.js: picture regions -> label grid -> exact EDT from every outline -> rows = iso-contours of the distance at (j + 0.5) x pitch (marching squares, chained, resampled at pitch) -> tiles; set times by phase (rows progressively from an anchor, or radial from the figure).
notes.sound: one click per 1/24 s bin of tile landings (gain ~ sqrt(count), pitch by stone/glass/gold share); penScratch per sinopia line; chimes across the light sweep; rustle for the grout wipe; low pad bed.
